headline: WTI Crude Falls Over 5% on Global Oversupply Concerns
summary: January West Texas Intermediate crude oil sank over 5% as rising U.S. inventories and increased global supply outweighed Middle East supply disruption risks.
why: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) is a primary crude oil benchmark used to price petroleum products globally.

impacts.name: WTI Crude
impacts.why: Futures prices dropped over 5% amid growing global oversupply and expanding U.S. crude inventories.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: WTI crude futures fell over 5% as rising U.S. stockpiles and higher regional output fed market expectations of a global oil glut.
